reviewItem.question: For "The issuer will now more quickly retry when its linked Secret is updated to fix an issue that caused a high back-off timeout", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether an issuer's linked Secret is updated at runtime, since that update event is what triggers the affected retry/back-off path

proposed.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0 the issuer now retries more quickly when its linked Secret is updated, fixing an issue that previously caused a high back-off timeout.
